content.title: Recommendations for the treatment of transthyretin amyloidosis - cardiac amyloidosis

recommendations.statement: Tafamidis is recommended in patients with genetic testing proven hATTR-CA and NYHA class I or II symptoms to reduce symptoms, CV hospitalization and mortality.
recommendations.notes: hATTR-CA = hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis - cardiac amyloidosis; NYHA = New York Heart Association; CV = cardiovascular

recommendations.statement: Tafamidis is recommended in patients with wtTTR-CA and NYHA class I or II symptoms to reduce symptoms, CV hospitalization and mortality.
recommendations.notes: wtTTR-CA = wild-type transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis; NYHA = New York Heart Association; CV = cardiovascular

content.source_details: Page shows duplicated recommendation table (ESC 2021) with tafamidis recommendations for hATTR-CA and wtTTR-CA, Class I, Level B.

genes.context: Referenced in recommendation statements as 'hATTR-CA' and 'wtTTR-CA' in two duplicated recommendation tables recommending tafamidis for transthyretin (TTR)-related cardiac amyloidosis (NYHA class I–II).
